PRODUCTS.d: A low-foam gel cleanser that removes sunscreen and sweat without that tight feeling.
long: Our everyday cleanser for humid days. The soft gel lifts away sunscreen, oil and city dust, then rinses clean — skin feels fresh, not stripped.
Use morning and night on damp skin. Massage for 30 seconds, rinse with lukewarm water.

PRODUCTS.d: A watery, alcohol-free toner that preps skin for serum.
long: A light hydrating layer between cleanser and serum. Pat 3–4 drops into skin with your palms — no cotton pad needed.

PRODUCTS.d: A lightweight niacinamide serum for a smoother, more even look.
long: Our hero serum: 5% niacinamide in a fast-absorbing water serum that layers well under sunscreen and makeup.
Use 2–3 drops morning and/or night after toner. Patch test first if your skin is sensitive.

PRODUCTS.d: A rich-but-not-greasy cream for dry patches and air-conditioned offices.
long: For skin that feels tight after a day in air-con. A soft cream with ceramides that sinks in without a heavy film.

PRODUCTS.d: Oil-free hydration that feels like nothing on hot days.
long: A bouncy gel for oily and combination skin. Hydrates without shine and sits well under sunscreen.

PRODUCTS.d: A thin, no-white-cast sunscreen you'll actually wear every day.
long: The last step of every morning routine. Light fluid texture, no white cast, dries to a soft finish. Reapply every 2–3 hours outdoors.

PRODUCTS.d: A few drops at night for skin that wakes up softer.
long: A light facial oil blend to seal in your night routine. Press 2–3 drops into skin as the final step.

PRODUCTS.d: A weekly clay mask for oily T-zones.
long: Kaolin clay mask for once or twice a week. Leave on for 8–10 minutes, rinse before it fully dries.

PRODUCTS.d: Calm Gel Cleanser + Dew Serum + Daily Sun Fluid. The routine, sorted.
long: Everything you need for a simple morning routine, at a set price.
Includes Calm Gel Cleanser 100 ml, Dew Serum 30 ml and Daily Sun Fluid SPF50 50 ml.

PRODUCTS.d: The whole routine in carry-on sizes.
long: Four minis that fit in a toiletry bag: cleanser, toner, serum and sunscreen. Great for trying the range.
